تحتقرين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِرِينَ (taḥtaqirīna) /taħ.ta.qi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# تُحْتَقَرِينَ (tuḥtaqarīna) /tuħ.ta.qa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
